newsitem.title: PERU: Peru net reserves fall to $8.928 bln as of Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: Peru net reserves fall to $8.928 bln as of Dec 24.

text.p: Peru's net international reserves fell to $8.928 billion on December 24 from $8.962 billion the previous week, the central bank said on Friday.
The bank's foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short-term and long-term debt obligations, was $1.720 billion on the same day.
President Alberto Fujimori last month said the government expected Peru's international reserves to rise to more than $10 billion by mid-1998.
International reserves were $6.641 billion at the end of 1995.
